column1:
Dragon
By: BaconAircraft, with feedback from the community. <3

(Automatic by default)

Notes: This aircraft has relaxed stability and uses a rudimentary augmented control system. Mind your speed and attitude, especially in turns - otherwise its appetite for high AoA will send you to a smoking crater in no time.

About: A cynical conglomeration of parts exhibiting questionable building techniques all in the effort to save on parts, further complimented by utterly nefarious abuse of the new paint pattern tool. All to bring you this aircraft in this special livery ...let's just say ...it pays homage to a certain flight demo team. This was a lot of fun to make, and the end goal was to produce a high-performance jet aircraft that is fun to look at and fun to fly - even without weapons. The sky is your canvas, this is your high-AoA paintbrush. 

XML notes:
- Various rotators' massScale set to 0
- Scaled items inside cockpit

关于：这架飞机是把一堆部件用可疑的建造手法拼在一起（全为了省部件数量），再加上对新涂装图案工具的彻底滥用。一切都是为了给你这架特殊涂装的飞机……这么说吧……它是在向某支飞行表演队致敬。做它非常有意思，最终目标是造出一架好看又好玩的高性能喷气机——即使不带武器。天空是你的画布，这就是你那支大迎角画笔。

column1:
Stormvark (Remaster)
By: Shizzle Styx

AG1: Within Visual Range combat mode (jettisons heavy external weapons).
AG2: Deploys arrestor hook.
AG3: Deploys aerial-refuelling probe.
AG4: Fuel dump / dump-and-burn. Afterburner ignites the plume; it remains alight until this switch is off or fuel is empty.
AG5: Navigation and anti-collision lights.
AG6: Formation lights.
AG7: Canopy open & engine stop
AG8: Auto wing sweep control (default On).

Flaps: <0 for manual high-lift, >0 for automatic living wing.
VTOL: Manual wing sweep control (when AG8 OFF); high-speed sweep protection still applies.
Trim: Trim

Notes:
Super Wasp brings agility and style. Stormvark brings range and payload - the fighter equivalent of a freight train that thinks finesse is optional. Inspired by the misunderstood F-111B, embracing: go far, go fast, carry a worrying amount of explody things. Beauty & the Beast, if the Beast had afterburners and a bomb bay.

Weapons bay opens automatically when Lazy 50 is selected. BayDoors is the first custom variable; change the quoted weapon name there for another payload.

WVR full pull requests about 10.5 G, subject to available authority and AoA protection. Inboard flaps retract by WingPosition 0.20. Slat gloves open only below 0.45 while slats are deployed.

XML Modifications:
Scaled air brakes on wings.
column2:
Stormvark (Remaster)
By: Shizzle Styx

AG1: 近距格斗模式（抛弃沉重的外挂武器）。
AG2: 放下着舰钩。
AG3: 伸出空中受油探管。
AG4: 放油 / 放油点火。加力会点燃油雾，直到关闭此开关或燃油耗尽才熄灭。
AG5: 航行灯与防撞灯。
AG6: 编队灯。
AG7: 打开座舱盖并停车
AG8: 自动变后掠控制（默认开启）。

Flaps: 小于 0 为手动高升力，大于 0 为自动自适应机翼。
VTOL: 手动变后掠控制（AG8 关闭时有效）；高速后掠保护仍然生效。
Trim: 配平

说明：
Super Wasp 带来灵巧与风格，Stormvark 带来航程与载弹——就像一列认为自己不需要优雅的货运列车。灵感来自被误解的 F-111B，主打：飞得远、飞得快、带上多到让人不安的爆炸物。《美女与野兽》，只不过这只野兽有加力和弹舱。

选择「Lazy 50」时武器舱会自动打开。BayDoors 是第一个自定义变量，改动其中的武器名即可换装其他挂载。

近距格斗模式满拉约需 10.5 G，受可用操纵权限与迎角保护限制。内侧襟翼在 WingPosition 0.20 时收回；缝翼展开时，前缘缝翼护套仅在 0.45 以下打开。
